note:
Hotfix: the monster simulation was down

roamRadius and walkHome, added with the new leashing, read the rules through R.
R is a local of stepNpc, not a module-level binding, so both threw
ReferenceError on the first tick and took the whole simulation with it: no
monster moved, attacked or respawned anywhere in the world. The relay health
endpoint had been reporting it in simErr the whole time.

Both now take the rules as a parameter like every other helper in that file,
and the file is swept: no function reads a bare R.

ship.py also stops trying to merge generated files: version.json and the build
stamp are rewritten from the current run rather than three-way merged.
